Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, west Triangle, Quezon City http: //wvw.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 133 s. 2022 October 18, 2022 HON. ALENIS JAYA ASTRERO Sangguniang Kabataan Pederasyon President San Mateo, Isabela Dear SK Pederasyon President Astrero: This refers to your letter dated 6 August 2022 seeking for guidance and this Department's legal opinion regarding your status as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan of San Mateo, Isabela. In your letter, you stated the following antecedent facts: 1. On May 2018, you were duly elected as President of the Pambayang Pederasyon ng Sangguniang Kabataan which authorized you to sit as one of the ex-officio members of the Sangguniang Pambayan of San Mateo. 2. Allegedly, after the May 2022 National and Local Elections, the seven (7) Sangguniang Bayan Members (five regular members, one Sectoral representative for women and the Liga ng mga Barangay President) refused to recognized you as one of the ex-officio members on the basis that your ex-officio term has already expired pursuant to Section 508 (b) of the Local Government Code. (b) Sanggunian members of component cities and municipalities shall form a provincial federation and elect a board of directors and a set of officers headed by the president. The duly elected president of the provincial federation of sanggunian members of component cities and municipalities shall be an ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan concemed and shall serve as such only during his term of office as president of the provincial federation of sanggunian members of component cities and municipalities, which in no case shall be beyond the term of office of the Sanggunian Panlalawigan concemed. 3. The seven members of the Sangguniang Bayan requested you to submit a resolution to be signed by all Sangguniang Kabataan Chairperson that they are still endorsing you as their SK Pambayang Pederasyon President. 4. A resolution declaring all positions of the SK Pambayang Pederasyon vacant and calling for its reorganization was made signed may majority of the SK Chairpersons in your municipality. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Based on the foregoing submission, posed for this Department's opinion are the herein below quoted queries: 1. What is the meaning of the phrase "which in no case shall be beyond the term of office of the sangguniang panlalawigan concerned' as mentioned under Section 508(b) of the Local Government Code? 2. Does my term end also upon assumption of the new set of council? 3. Is there a need for resolution still endorsing me as the SK Pederasyon President when I am still the duly elected president as there is still no Barangay or SK Elections? 4. Was the resolution declaring all positions vacant and calling for the reorganization of the SK Pederasyon signed by the SK Chairpersons convening them in a meeting, valid? May it be a ground for me not to be recognized as ex officio SB Member? We shall answer the above enumerated in one discussion since the issues raised are interrelated. The Department in its Memorandum Circular 2010-821 clarifying the term of office of Philippine Councilors ex-officio members in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, had exhaustively explained what is meant by the phrase "which in no case shall be beyond the term of office of the sangguniang panlalawigan concemed" under the aforecited provisions of the Code. "The discussion thereof is worth quoting at length, thus: "The phrase, 'which in no case shall be beyond the term of office of the sangguniang panlalawigan concemed' is stated for the purpose of reckoning the existence of the sanggunian concemed as a collective body (as in the case of the Presidents of the Liga ng mga Barangay and the Sangguniang Kabataan Federation, DILG Opinion Nos. 73- 2001 and 54-2004). The right to assume or remain in any of the positions enumerated in Section 4679(a) of RA 7160 should not be exclusively associated with the "term of office of the sanggunian panlalawigan concemed". Such term does not necessarily coincide, for example, when: (1) one's proclamation has been deferred due to an election protest, or (2) he has not yet qualified (i.e., has not taken oath and assumed the office), or (3) one is removed or suspended from office, or (4) one's term of office expired pursuant to Section 43 of RA 7160. The case is entirely different for one who is permitted to sit in the "previous term of office of the sanggunian" as well as in the "beginning of the term of office of the new sanggunian'l under a hold-over capacity, as in the case of the presidents of the Liga ng mga Barangay, the SK Federation and the PCL. 1 Status or Term of Office of PCL Ex-Officio Members in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan Page 2 of 4

In connection thereto, the pronouncements of the Department under its Legal Opinion No. 54 Series of 2004 pertaining to the term of office of the Liga ng mga Barangay Chapter Presidents in the provinces, cities and municipalities as ex-officio members of the sanggunian concerned is restated below: "In reply to your query, please be informed that admittedly, the election of new set of local elective officials on May IO, 2004 gave rise to an issue of perceived vacancies in the ex-officio seats in all levels of the sanggunian due to the provisions of Section 494 of the Local Govemment Code of 1991, which states: "The duly elected presidents of the Liga at the municipal, city andprovincial levels, including the component cities and municipalities of Metropolitan Manila, shall serve as ex-officio members of the sangguniang bayan, sangguniang panlungsod, sangguniang panlalawigan, respectively. They shall sen'e as such only during their term of office as president of the liga chapters which in no case shall go beyond the term of office of the sanggunian concemed. " The foregoing section provides that the Liga ng mga Barangay Chapter Presidents shall serve as ex-officio members in their respective. sanggunians during their term of office as presidents of the Liga ng mga Barangay Chapters which in no case shall be beyond the term of office of the sanggunian concemed. However, the latter qualification is stated only for the purpose of reckoning the existence of the sanggunian as a collective body. Hence. when the terms of the new sanqgunians commence at noon on June 30 2004 it is a new term for the sanggunian as a collective body of which the Liga Chapter Presidents of the different levels have the right to sit as ex-officio members therein. Their right to sit as ex-officio members emanated from a statutory grant and hence. should be effected by operation of law. Hence, in the technical sense, the term Of Office Of the Liga ng mga Barangay Chapter Presidents in the provinces, cities and municipalities as ex- officio members of the sanggunian concemed shall expire at noon of June 30, 2004, together with the old set of sanggunian members. However, on the very same date when the new set of elected sanggunian officials assume their respective offices and convene as a collegial body, the same Liga ng mga Barangay Chapter Presidents, by statutory right, still being the federation presidents are likewise entitled to sit as ex-officio members of the sanggunian concemed without need of any further appointment, recognition nor confirmation as said assumption is by operation of law per Section 494 of the Local Govemment Code. The same principle laid down above shall apply with respect to the SK Federation Presidents who sit as ex-officio members in the sangguniang bayan, sangguniang panlungsod and sangguniang panlalawigan. Page 3 of 4

Hence, to answer your query squarely, your ex-officio term as member of the Sangguniang Bayan of the Municipality of San Mateo did not expire when the new set of elected sanggunian officials assumed their respective offices. Also, it is very clear that the resolution declaring all positions vacant and calling for the reorganization Of the SK Pederasyon is without any legal basis. The opinion of this Department is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated and our appreciation of the same. Further, this opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of component authorities and the courts. We hope we have assisted you on the matter. Thank you very much. Very truly yours, B THORITY OF THE SECRETARY: . JUAN TOR R. LLAMAS U d ecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLNJVRULRALLD/jvpr Copy furnished: DIR. JONATHAN PAUL M. LEUSEN, JR.
